source_rows.Name: Ya'sta Club
source_rows.january_findings: Ya'sta Club has a dated events calendar for its regular BearbiePOP, drag bingo and other LGBTQ sessions; accessible listing displays August–September 2026 and an indexed January 2026 view, but no reliable January 2027 date. Do not extrapolate its weekly programme into January; there is no verified men-only darkroom event for the target month.

source_rows.Name: LIMAX
source_rows.january_findings: Official LIMAX naked electronic dance party site displays 26 September 2026 as next party and 19 December 2026 as last 2026 date. Sex-positive playroom but admits all bodies, genders and identities; no January 2027 date and not men-only.

source_rows.Name: FETIXX
source_rows.january_findings: FETIXX is explicitly a queer men-only Berlin fetish party; the available official page advertises 13 September 2026 at Insomnia, with no confirmed January 2027 edition. Retain as future qualifying candidate but do not create a dated January event.

source_rows.Name: GEGEN
source_rows.january_findings: Official GEGEN upcoming calendar lists 22 January GEGEN PANDEMONIUM [16YRS] at KitKatClub Berlin and 29 January GLUE x GEGEN at TBA Zagreb. Resident Advisor explicitly confirms the Berlin event as 22 January 2027, 20:00–09:00; event welcomes people irrespective of gender and sexual orientation. Exclude from Backroom's men-only listings rather than inventing men-only admission.

source_rows.Name: Insomnia Berlin
source_rows.january_findings: Official Insomnia party-list archive accessible in indexed content shows August 2026 dated entries; the club hosts mixed swinger, fetish, sex-positive and queer sessions. No independently confirmed January 2027 *men-only* hosted event in the accessible calendar; FETIXX's September 2026 event cannot be rolled forward.

source_rows.Name: Polish Leather Uniform Group
source_rows.january_findings: Official Polish Leather Uniform Group website times out; the www variant was also inaccessible. Search for January 2027/Polish-language events did not return a verifiable dated official listing. Leave prospective events unconfirmed.

source_rows.Name: Bi Pride Uk
source_rows.january_findings: Official Bi Pride UK site advertises an inclusive public festival on Saturday 29 August 2026 at Kings Place, London; archived events page contains earlier editions. No January 2027 dated men-only darkroom party; inclusive bi+ pride programme is out of Backroom's men-only remit.

source_rows.Name: International Bears Sitges Week 2026
source_rows.january_findings: Official Bears Sitges Week site announces 2027 festival for 3–12 September, with Bear-Village 6–12 September. Programme details still say coming soon and include older 2025 text. Nothing supports a January 2027 edition; do not treat old programme as new.

source_rows.Name: Malta Pride 2026
source_rows.january_findings: Official Malta Pride site advertises Valletta Pride 4–13 September 2026; public events calendar belongs to September festival coverage. No qualifying dated January 2027 men-only darkroom event.

source_rows.Name: Folsom Street Fair 2026
source_rows.january_findings: Folsom Street Fair's official detail page lists Sunday 27 September 2026; homepage also shows the next edition on 26 September 2027, and Up Your Alley on 25 July 2027. No January 2027 fair; this inclusive street fair is not a men-only darkroom party.

source_rows.Name: Atlanta Pride Festival 2026
source_rows.january_findings: Official Atlanta Pride events page lists September–October 2026 festivals and community Pride activities, with no confirmed January 2027 men-only darkroom events. Keep old festival dates separate from 2027 audit.

source_rows.Name: Taiwan LGBT+ Pride 2026
source_rows.january_findings: Official Taiwan LGBT+ Pride Linktree identifies 24th parade as Saturday 31 October 2026. No January 2027 programme or men's cruising party confirmed from supplied official links.

source_rows.Name: Palm Springs Pride 2026
source_rows.january_findings: Official Palm Springs Pride home announces festival 6–8 November 2026 and its event calendar displays the 7 November 2026 run/walk. No verified January 2027 men-only darkroom parties.

source_rows.Name: Palm Springs Pride Parade 2026
source_rows.january_findings: Official Palm Springs Pride Parade page gives Sunday 8 November 2026 at 10:00; this is a public parade, not a January 2027 men-only nightlife event. Same organising website as index 799 but preserved as separate audit row.

source_rows.Name: CSD Bremen Demonstration and Festival 2026
source_rows.january_findings: Official CSD Bremen page announces Saturday 22 August 2026; the events calendar lists August 2026 Pride-week events. No verified January 2027 men's darkroom event; all-ages public CSD parade/festival itself is not eligible.

source_rows.Name: CSD Magdeburg 2026
source_rows.january_findings: Official CSD Magdeburg states festival/action weeks 14–30 August 2026 and demonstration 22 August 2026. Current accessible content does not verify January 2027 men-only darkroom nightlife.

source_rows.Name: Manchester Village Pride 2026
source_rows.january_findings: Official Manchester Village Pride 2026 programme covers 28–31 August (launch, parade, party stages, family/community day). No January 2027 date for a men-only darkroom event. Shared organiser and site with indices 808 and 810.

source_rows.Name: Manchester Village Pride Parade 2026
source_rows.january_findings: Manchester Village Pride organiser specifically lists its parade on Saturday 29 August 2026. No January 2027 parade/event, and a public mixed Pride procession is not an eligible men's darkroom event. Duplicate organiser/URL of index 807.

source_rows.Name: Southampton Pride 2026
source_rows.january_findings: Southampton Pride's official home announces tenth-anniversary Pride weekend 29–30 August 2026. The inclusive public festival has no verified January 2027 men-only darkroom programme.

source_rows.Name: Southampton Pride March 2026
source_rows.january_findings: The Southampton Pride March listing shares the same official source and August 2026 festival context as index 809. No January 2027 men-only darkroom date; retain the duplicate row in audit for traceability.
